record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity
record.original_question: Prove that perturbations of the Schwarzschild and Kerr black-hole solutions decay exponentially, establishing black-hole stability in the sense suggested by physical and linearized arguments.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(\mathcal{M}, g)$ be a smooth, asymptotically flat, vacuum Lorentzian 4-manifold solving the Einstein vacuum equations $\mathrm{Ric}(g)=0$. For parameters $0\le |a|\le m$, let $g_{a,m}$ denote the Kerr metric on the maximally extended exterior region (with $a=0$ giving the Schwarzschild metric of mass $m$).

Consider an asymptotically flat Cauchy initial data set $(\Sigma,\bar g,k)$ for the Einstein vacuum equations that is sufficiently close, in a suitable weighted Sobolev topology, to the induced data of a Kerr solution with parameters $(a_0,m_0)$, $|a_0|<m_0$. Let $(\mathcal{M},g)$ denote its maximal globally hyperbolic future development.

Prove that:
(i) $(\mathcal{M},g)$ possesses a complete future null infinity $\mathcal{I}^+$ and a regular event horizon $\mathcal{H}^+$;
(ii) in the exterior region $\mathcal{M}\setminus J^-(\mathcal{I}^+)^c$, the metric $g$ converges, as one approaches $\mathcal{I}^+$ and $\mathcal{H}^+$, to a member $g_{a_\infty,m_\infty}$ of the Kerr family with final parameters $(a_\infty,m_\infty)$ close to $(a_0,m_0)$;
(iii) the convergence is at an exponential rate along the event horizon and along suitable timelike foliations approaching $\mathcal{I}^+$, with respect to natural geometric norms.

The problem is to establish this nonlinear asymptotic stability statement for the full subextremal Kerr family $|a|<m$ (including the Schwarzschild case $a=0$).
artifact.category_tag: Black hole stability in general relativity
artifact.status_search_result: Nonlinear stability of Schwarzschild has been proven (Dafermos–Holzegel–Rodnianski–Taylor), and Giorgi–Klainerman–Szeftel established nonlinear stability of Kerr for sufficiently small angular momentum |a|/m ≪ 1 (series of papers culminating in 2021–2022). Linear stability in the full subextremal range |a|<m has recent results (e.g., a 2025 preprint), but full nonlinear stability of Kerr throughout the entire subextremal range remains open. Exponential decay rates as posed are also not established in full generality (polynomial decay is what is currently proved).

status_evidence.title: Kerr stability for small angular momentum
status_evidence.snippet: Klainerman and Szeftel prove nonlinear stability of Kerr for small a/m.
status_evidence.claim: Nonlinear Kerr stability proved for small angular momentum.

status_evidence.title: Black hole stability conjecture - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Series of papers by Giorgi, Klainerman, Szeftel proves the conjecture for slowly rotating Kerr.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture proved for slowly rotating Kerr; general subextremal case open.

status_evidence.title: Linear stability of Kerr black holes in the full subextremal range
status_evidence.snippet: Linear stability of Kerr in full subextremal range.
status_evidence.claim: Only linear (not nonlinear) stability established in full subextremal range.
